function inner_loop!(u::Vector{Point3f}, eigenstates, eigenstate_amplitudes, ki, ai, basis_function, xyz, ku, U, i)
    state = eigenstates[i]
    amplitude = eigenstate_amplitudes[i]
    k = ki[state]
    a = ai[state]
    for j in eachindex(xyz)
        b = basis_function(xyz[j], k, a, ku, U)
        u[j] += amplitude .* b
    end
end

function calculate_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField)
    time_step = Int(vf.ui_states.time_step)
    eigenstates = validate_eigenstate_string(vf)
    amplitudes = vf.amplitudes
    eigenstate_amplitudes = map(es -> amplitudes[time_step, es], eigenstates)
    ki = vf.ki
    ai = vf.ai
    xyz = vf.xyz
    ku, U = vf.ku, vf.U
    basis_function = vf.basis_function
    base_flow_func = vf.base_flow_func
    
    u = fill(Point3f(0, 0, 0), length(xyz))
    for i in eachindex(eigenstates)
        inner_loop!(u, eigenstates, eigenstate_amplitudes, ki, ai, basis_function, xyz, ku, U, i)
    end

    if vf.ui_states.base_flow
        for (i, point) in enumerate(xyz)
            u[i] += base_flow_func(point, ku, U)
        end
    end

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir=vf.data_dir,
        file_paths=vf.file_paths,
        xyz=vf.xyz,
        n=vf.n,
        ui_states=vf.ui_states,
        u=u,
        amplitudes=vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps=vf.time_steps,
        ki=vf.ki,
        ai=vf.ai,
        ku=vf.ku,
        U=vf.U,
        flow_type=vf.flow_type,
        basis_function=vf.basis_function,
        base_flow_func=vf.base_flow_func
    )
end

"""
    inner_loop_single_eigenstate!(u, state, amplitude, ki, ai, basis_function, xyz, ku, U)

Compute contribution of a single eigenstate to the velocity field.

# Arguments
- `u::Vector{Point3f}`: Velocity field to accumulate into
- `state::Int`: Eigenstate index
- `amplitude`: Eigenstate amplitude
- `ki::Vector{Point3f}`: Wave numbers
- `ai::Vector{Point3f}`: Eigenvectors
- `basis_function`: Type-stable basis function
- `xyz::Vector{Point3f}`: Grid positions
- `ku, U`: Base flow parameters
"""
function inner_loop_single_eigenstate!(
    u::Vector{Point3f},
    state::Int,
    amplitude,
    ki::Vector{Point3f},
    ai::Vector{Point3f},
    basis_function,
    xyz::Vector{Point3f},
    ku, U
)
    k = ki[state]
    a = ai[state]
    for j in eachindex(xyz)
        b = basis_function(xyz[j], k, a, ku, U)
        u[j] += amplitude * b
    end
    return u
end

"""
    calculate_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField)

Calculate velocity field using multi-threaded computation.

Partitions eigenstates across threads and computes partial sums in parallel,
then reduces the results. This avoids race conditions while maximizing throughput.

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: Velocity field object with grid and eigenstate data

# Returns
- `VelocityField`: New velocity field with computed velocities
"""
function calculate_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField)
    time_step = Int(vf.ui_states.time_step)
    eigenstates = validate_eigenstate_string(vf)
    amplitudes = vf.amplitudes
    eigenstate_amplitudes = map(es -> amplitudes[time_step, es], eigenstates)
    ki = vf.ki
    ai = vf.ai
    xyz = vf.xyz
    ku, U = vf.ku, vf.U
    basis_function = vf.basis_function
    base_flow_func = vf.base_flow_func
    
    # Partition eigenstates to distribute work evenly across threads
    tasks_per_thread = 2
    chunk_size = max(1, length(eigenstates) ÷ (tasks_per_thread * nthreads()))
    chunks = partition(collect(eachindex(eigenstates)), chunk_size)

    # Each task computes a local partial sum and returns it (no race conditions)
    tasks = map(chunks) do chunk
        @spawn begin
            local_u = fill(Point3f(0, 0, 0), length(xyz))
            for i in chunk
                state = eigenstates[i]
                amplitude = eigenstate_amplitudes[i]
                inner_loop_single_eigenstate!(local_u, state, amplitude, ki, ai, basis_function, xyz, ku, U)
            end
            return local_u
        end
    end

    # Safely reduce results (no races)
    results = fetch.(tasks)
    u = reduce((a, b) -> a .+ b, results)

    # Add base flow if active
    if vf.ui_states.base_flow
        for (i, point) in enumerate(xyz)
            u[i] += base_flow_func(point, ku, U)
        end
    end

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir=vf.data_dir,
        file_paths=vf.file_paths,
        xyz=vf.xyz,
        n=vf.n,
        ui_states=vf.ui_states,
        u=u,
        amplitudes=vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps=vf.time_steps,
        ki=vf.ki,
        ai=vf.ai,
        ku=vf.ku,
        U=vf.U,
        flow_type=vf.flow_type,
        basis_function=vf.basis_function,
        base_flow_func=vf.base_flow_func
    )
end
